verdict.rationale: Slack's first-party docs describe multiple AI-generated insight features surfaced directly in-product: daily 'Today' briefings, Slackbot AI agent for meeting prep/report analysis/project briefs, channel/thread summarization and recaps, AI-powered search across integrated data sources, and huddle note-taking with action items — all delivered natively within Slack's UI. This directly matches the story of getting AI-generated insights from one's own workspace data inside the product.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of summarization or briefing quality, and no detail on accuracy or limitations of these AI features.
